scope: FM arm uses the reused128 empirical physically corrected references. Trajectory-force/work arms use512 provisional endpoints from256 frozen-parent TRAIN trajectories, with no chemical validity rejection. The work target is the self-normalized finite-particle mean of a local Gaussian-restrained eSEN energy tilt inside a1-Angstrom Frobenius ball; zero-support states fall back to force and are retained.
